preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100000 and 0 <= x <= y <= n for n, x, y in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 10^5, and 0 <= x <= y <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= b <= n + 1 for b in guess) for n, guess in test_cases_data)
preconditions.description: Each element in Bob's guess is an integer between 1 and n+1 inclusive.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] in ['YES','yes','Yes','yEs','yeS','YES','Yes','YES']) or (stdout_lines[2*i] in ['NO','no','No','nO','NO','No','NO','no']) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case output is 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] in ['YES','yes','Yes','yEs','yeS','YES','Yes','YES']) and (len(stdout_lines[2*i+1].split()) == n and all(1 <= int(v) <= n+1 for v in stdout_lines[2*i+1].split())) for i, (n, x, y, guess) in enumerate(zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_guesses)) if stdout_lines[2*i] in ['YES','yes','Yes','yEs','yeS','YES','Yes','YES'])
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the second line contains n integers between 1 and n+1.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] in ['NO','no','No','nO','NO','No','NO','no']) and (not exists_valid_code(n, x, y, guess)) for i, (n, x, y, guess) in enumerate(zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_guesses)) if stdout_lines[2*i] in ['NO','no','No','nO','NO','No','NO','no'])
postconditions.description: If the answer is NO, no valid secret code exists for the given n, x, y, and guess.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[2*i] in ['YES','yes','Yes','yEs','yeS','YES','Yes','YES']) and (x == sum(1 for j in range(n) if int(stdout_lines[2*i+1].split()[j]) == guess[j]) and y == sum(min(guess.count(c), secret.count(c)) for c in set(guess))) for i, (n, x, y, guess) in enumerate(zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_guesses)) if stdout_lines[2*i] in ['YES','yes','Yes','yEs','yeS','YES','Yes','YES'])
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the output code satisfies the given x (exact matches) and y (multiset intersection size) constraints.
